findings.text: The module docstring still says that this file shows "the second term has every row of the first", but the commit moved that fact to `Resolved.project_selected_subset` in `Queries/Evaluation/TwoStateKeptRows.lean`, and the resolution record `20261127T084954Z-a405b642#1` in this commit marks the same finding as fixed although the sentence is unchanged. Fix: change the sentence to say that the file gives the condition under which the rows that a predicate keeps remain after the delete, and refer to `Resolved.project_selected_subset` for the inclusion of the terms.

The restatement of `Resolved.selected_subset_deleted_iff` calls the rows that `keep` accepts "selected", which is the model's word for the rows that the DELETE selects (`LiteralData.selected`), and it does not say that `Resolved.conditionKeeps` is applied to the DELETE filter in the delete's context. Fix: write "every scanned row value for which `keep` is true occurs in the scan after the delete exactly when `Resolved.conditionKeeps` of the DELETE filter is false for each such value".
